name: Select Mesh
description: Selects which mesh should be used to represent the 3D entity.

name: LOD Manager Options
description: Set and Get information about the LOD Manager.

settings.name: Modify Parameters
settings.default_value: Activate,Global LOD Factor,Build Normals For Progressive Meshes

name: Sine Deform
description: Applies a time-dependent sinusoidal deformation to each vertice of the mesh.

name: Mesh Morpher
description: Makes a mesh out of two (that must have the same number of vertices).

name: Set Face Count
description: Set the number of faces of a mesh.

name: Set Face Properties
description: Set the properties of a Face.

name: Texture Displace
description: Displaces the vertices of the mesh, according to the luminosity of the texture mapped to this vertex.

name: Noise
description: Displaces the vertices of the mesh with a random vector.

name: Read Midi
description: Reads a Midi signal.

name: Set PatchMesh Steps
description: Sets number of steps used to render a PatchMesh.

name: Set Vertex Properties
description: Set the properties of a vertex.

name: Remove Mesh
description: Removes a mesh from the selected 3d Entity.

name: Explode
description: Makes an object appear to explode by spreading out its faces from the barycenter of the object.

name: Precompute Lighting
description: Precompute the lighting of an object.

name: Vertex Translate
description: Translates one or more vertices of the current mesh.

name: Set LOD Attribute
description: Set the LOD Attribute on an object.

settings.name: Modify Parameters
settings.default_value: Multiple Meshes,Character Animation,Patch Mesh,Alpha,Screen Mag,Screen Min,Face Mag,Face Min,Screen Alpha Mag,Screen Alpha Min

name: Taper
description: Modifies the mesh by scaling one end of it and changes the amount of tapering and the curvature of the effect.

name: Set Progressive Mesh Options
description: Sets the options of the progressive mesh.

name: Stretch
description: Stretches an object, equivalent to scaling it with a stretch factor along the selected axis and with the opposite factor along the two other axes.

name: Invert Winding
description: Inverse the orientation of the faces of a mesh.

name: Skin Join
description: Deforms a join so it sticks on the objects it's joined.

name: CD Player
description: Plays soundtracks from an audio CD (v2).

name: Set Midi Input Port
description: Sets the Midi Input Port (usally 0).

name: Set Vertex Count
description: Set the number of Vertexs of a mesh.

name: Object Rename
description: Renames an object

name: Multi Mesh Morpher
description: Transforms the current mesh so it matches the interpolation of other meshes (ie there vertice)

name: Change Referential
description: Change the referential of a specified object, with another object referential.

name: Switch On Midi
description: Activates the appropriate output when receiving a Midi event.

name: Get LOD Attribute
description: Get the LOD Attribute parameters applied to an object.

name: Twist
description: Twists an object around an axis. You can choose the angle of twisting and the bias, ranging from -100 to 100.

name: Add Mesh
description: Adds a mesh to the selected 3d Entity.

name: Midi Event
description: Gets a Midi event ON/OFF.

name: Bend
description: Bends a mesh uniformly along an axis with an angle and a direction of bending.

name: Midi Player
description: Plays/Stops a MIDI sound.
